changelog.summary: Use fast Proxmox VE cluster resource routes for bounded storage and guest inventory while preserving partial degradation and audited lifecycle controls.
entries: Read storage once from /cluster/resources?type=storage instead of issuing slower per-node storage requests.
Remove the obsolete dynamic per-node storage scope and continue bounding storage records inside the Module.
Retain the Proxmox VE 9-compatible query-free /cluster/tasks route and bounded recent-task parsing.
Inject the PVE API token Authorization header in NAD core and keep the token secret opaque to Module code.
Add audited start, stop, and restart requests with UPID normalization and observed or explicitly indeterminate task outcomes.
Reserve, but deliberately do not implement, console access.

preserves: config keys api_url, token_id, token_secret, verify_ssl
widget ids node-overview, guest-list, resource-summary, task-log
